name: Nazi Party (NSDAP)
description: Adolf Hitler's party, founded in 1920, which became Germany's sole party in 1933 and imposed totalitarian dictatorship, biological racism and antisemitism, rearmament and military expansion until its defeat in 1945.

name: Republican Party
description: One of the two major US parties, right-wing and now led by Donald Trump, it advocates low taxes, deregulation, immigration control, tariffs, traditional Christian values and the right to bear arms.

name: Republican Party (New Deal era)
description: Opposition to Franklin Roosevelt from 1933 to 1945, it defended balanced budgets, less federal power and free enterprise, with isolationist and internationalist wings, against the New Deal and strong unions.

name: Democratic Party
description: The other major US party, center-left, it advocates expanding public healthcare, civil and reproductive rights, unions, environmental regulation and international alliances, with a base among minorities, young people and big cities.

name: Vox
description: Spanish radical-right party founded in 2013, it defends national unity against separatism, immigration restriction, traditional family and Catholic values, tax cuts, and criticism of the EU and feminism.

name: Chinese Communist Party
description: Sole ruling party since 1949, it combines Leninism and state control of politics, media and the internet with a state-directed market economy, industrial planning, nationalism and technological modernization.

name: Al-Qaeda
description: Salafi jihadist organization founded by Osama bin Laden in 1988, it advocates a global caliphate, war against the West and regimes deemed apostate, and strict Islamic law, with attacks such as September 11, 2001.

name: Brazilian Integralist Action (AIB)
description: Movement founded by Plínio Salgado in 1932, with the motto 'God, Fatherland and Family', it advocated a corporatist integral state, nationalism, anti-communism and Catholic morality, with a green-shirt militia, until banned in 1937.

name: House of Habsburg
description: Catholic dynasty that ruled Austria-Hungary, it upheld hereditary multinational monarchy, the emperor's authority, the alliance with the Church and the unity of the empire, until Charles I's abdication in 1918.

name: House of Orléans-Braganza
description: Branch of the Brazilian imperial dynasty descended from Pedro II, it maintains claimants to the throne and advocates parliamentary monarchy in Brazil, with a tradition of ties to the Catholic Church.
